goal: Fresh TypeScript UI with V1 look and workflows and current V2 browser capabilities.

assignments.title: T1 - Open the compiled TypeScript shell
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns compilation and asset serving only; reuses api.mjs and current bootstrap. Go REST payloads, date conventions and CSP stay fixed.
assignments.demo: Launch an isolated Go candidate with a seeded board. Open /, follow its board link and reload /boards/{board_id}; show the real board name and a recoverable missing-board state.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T2 - Scan the familiar board
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns rendering and local filter state; consumes typed confirmed board data and current list/view contracts.
assignments.demo: Open a dense seeded board through its ordinary URL, filter by ticket, clear with Escape, reveal older Completed cards and scroll two lanes independently.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Bounded presentation or feature behavior over accepted shared contracts.

assignments.title: T2 - See live workspace attention
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns catalog state and event subscription wiring; reuses board-updates.mjs and workspace/catalog APIs.
assignments.demo: Open the candidate workspace and one board. Change another board through Bot CLI, observe attention and tab changes, then interrupt and restore the connection.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T3 - Read a card in context
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns drawer presentation and lifecycle; reuses card-prose.mjs and focused read APIs.
assignments.demo: Open a card by keyboard, follow its archived child and a prose ticket link, read long content, switch boards with the drawer open and close back to a valid focus target.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Bounded presentation or feature behavior over accepted shared contracts.

assignments.title: T3 - Keep the selected board current safely
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns read arbitration and revision/ETag pairing; reuses createBoardRefresh/watchUpdates and current conditional reads.
assignments.demo: Delay a board read, navigate to another board and release the old response. Disconnect, perform a Bot edit, reconnect and use Retry board update while checking the correct board remains displayed.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T3 - Pin boards and adjust the sidebar
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns pin and sidebar-control state; shares workspace ETag with publishing through the accepted context interface.
assignments.demo: Pin two boards, reorder with both keyboard and pointer, introduce a concurrent pin edit, resolve it, then resize, collapse, reload and reopen the sidebar.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T4 - Return to a board with its view intact
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns per-tab UI state schema and route restoration; service state remains authoritative.
assignments.demo: Filter and scroll two boards differently, open a drawer, navigate through Back/Forward and reload; verify the correct per-board state and missing-card fallback.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T4 - Edit exact card text with recoverable drafts
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns reusable scoped submission/draft primitives and text-specific matching. Uses api.mjs; numeric revisions and HTTP ETags stay distinct.
assignments.demo: Edit Unicode multiline text, cause a concurrent stale refusal, inspect saved state, then lose a write response and reload to inspect the original submission while preserving the draft.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T5 - Show confirmed recent boards within a cache budget
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns display-only cache and budget preference; consumes S05 confirming read state.
assignments.demo: Set a small budget on Workspace, visit several boards to cause eviction, revisit a retained board offline, retry online and set budget to zero.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T5 - Create a card from its lane
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns creation presentation and create-specific recovery; reuses S09 primitives and createCard contract.
assignments.demo: Open New card from a permitted lane, select a nondefault owner and priority, enter a multiline description, and submit using Add card. Verify those fields in saved state, recover the selections after cancel/reopen, and inspect an uncertain creation without creating a duplicate.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T5 - Move cards with pointer and keyboard
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns movement state and drop handlers; consumes current policy grants and card patch contract.
assignments.demo: Move with keyboard and drag, attempt a forbidden drop, then race a Bot move and inspect the saved destination.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T5 - Assign owners and individual priorities
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns owner/priority presentation; consumes member and priority domain values and existing card PATCH APIs.
assignments.demo: Assign another member, raise priority, attempt a dependency-blocked demotion and verify exact saved owner/priority after a stale edit.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T5 - Read and post comments and activity
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns comment/history presentation and comment-specific recovery; current list paging, IDs and timestamp formats stay fixed.
assignments.demo: Enter a multiline comment using Shift+Enter, post with Enter, then simulate a lost response and reload to inspect the original comment without duplication. Verify composition does not submit, then open recent comments and history.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T5 - Follow and maintain typed relationships
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns relationship editor and recovery; reuses current relationship endpoints and S09 submission primitives.
assignments.demo: Add a blocking link, change a reference kind, follow an archived target, remove a link and inspect an addition whose response was lost.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T5 - Find and restore active or archived work
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns search/archive controls and view-state extension; server search ordering and archive contracts remain authoritative.
assignments.demo: Search comment content in triage order, open an archived hit, restore it, archive another card and return through Back/Forward with the query intact.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T5 - Preview and manage saved attachments
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns saved-file presentation and cover/detach handlers; reuses validated attachment APIs.
assignments.demo: Download a binary and compare bytes, preview two images, set/clear a cover, then detach the selected image and observe the remaining fallback.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T5 - Configure and inspect automatic publishing
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns settings/status UI; shared workspace ETag and existing publishing APIs remain authoritative.
assignments.demo: Use a disposable Git-backed fixture, toggle board/workspace publishing, make an edit, observe publication and introduce a failed destination while preserving concurrent pins.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T5 - Create, close and reopen boards
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns board lifecycle UI; existing creation/availability APIs and publisher-drain behavior remain fixed.
assignments.demo: Create a generic board from Workspace, add a draft, close it, use another board, then reopen the same URL and recover the draft; inspect a lost availability response.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T5 - Inspect and stop the service
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns service status/stop UI; current administration grant, service ETag and lifecycle contracts remain fixed.
assignments.demo: On an isolated candidate, inspect service/build status, cause a controlled flush refusal, resolve the fixture, save a final edit and request graceful stop; verify durable saved state.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T6 - Seed typed links during creation
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns seed-link integration only; atomicity remains in existing createCard/Go contract.
assignments.demo: Create a card with two typed links, try an invalid seed and verify no card was created, then inspect a lost successful response.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T6 - Approve one reviewed card
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns single-approval UI and receipt recovery; consumes existing approval API/UUIDv7 convention.
assignments.demo: Approve one Ready for Review card, verify its comment/move receipt, then lose another approval response and inspect it after reload.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T6 - Upload files to an existing card
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns live batch state and file handling; reuses current limits, hashes and upload contract.
assignments.demo: Paste an image and pick a binary, reject an oversize item, switch cards while upload finishes, then inspect an original upload with a lost response.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T6 - Set batch priorities
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns batch-priority controls; current transactional priority API and dependency rules remain fixed.
assignments.demo: Select two ticket numbers, change priority, verify upstream effects, then submit an invalid/stale selection and confirm no partial change.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T6 - Preview and apply dependency ticket order
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns preview/apply presentation; current ordering endpoints and atomicity remain authoritative.
assignments.demo: Preview a dependent lane, inspect proposed tickets, apply and verify stable card IDs; generate another preview, change a card and observe stale refusal.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T6 - Capture and download a native backup
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns capture/download UI and state; existing backup IDs, digest and immutable snapshot contracts stay fixed.
assignments.demo: Capture a board, edit another card while it runs, navigate away and return, then download and verify the older captured revision and file bytes.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T6 - Activate a staged build and reconnect
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns activation UI/session replacement wiring; current Go activation, receipt and capability semantics remain fixed.
assignments.demo: Stage an isolated candidate build, activate through its ordinary Workspace controls, reconnect at the same board URL, inspect the original receipt and save a final card edit.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T7 - Approve a complete lane
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns bulk approval UI; existing atomic membership validation and receipt contract remain fixed.
assignments.demo: Approve a complete lane, verify every affected card and comment, then change membership between render and submit and observe refusal.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T7 - Resume interrupted file batches
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns bounded persisted upload metadata and recovery interpretation; shares S09 inspection state.
assignments.demo: Reload a partially successful batch, inspect pending IDs, reject a changed original, reselect the exact files and finish with one copy of each.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T7 - Restore a native backup
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns restore UI and post-restore reconciliation; current restoration API/preconditions remain fixed.
assignments.demo: Capture then edit a board, restore the earlier ZIP, verify attachments and retained draft, restore a version missing the open card and reject a damaged ZIP.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T7 - Publish a captured backup
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns publication UI; immutable backup publication API and UUIDv7/time conventions stay fixed.
assignments.demo: Publish a captured backup, edit the live board meanwhile, navigate away/back, refresh the original job and verify the destination commit contains the captured bytes.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T8 - Stage attachments during card creation
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns staged-file handoff to confirmed creation; existing create and upload transaction boundaries stay fixed.
assignments.demo: Create a card with two links and staged image/binary files, force the later upload to fail, reopen that saved card and resume the remaining file.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T8 - Maintain lane configuration
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Owns lane administration UI; existing lane APIs, grants and protected Completed role remain authoritative.
assignments.demo: Open Board settings, add and rename a lane, change its key, save custom approval text, reject nonempty retirement and retire it once empty.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

assignments.title: T9 - Qualify the complete candidate for handoff
owned_files: web tests and candidate verification report
assignments.integration_touchpoints: Parent owns integrated evidence, obsolete-asset removal decision and handoff. Accepted #0512 outcome is an external prerequisite; its acceptance is checked without adding a forward story dependency.
assignments.demo: Launch the complete isolated Go candidate, execute a seeded create/edit/link/upload/approve/archive/restore chain and operations checks, then compare V1 and new screenshots at matching supported viewports.
assignments.review_model_rationale: Shared contract, concurrency, recovery, authorization or integrated qualification.

fga_consultation.use: Advisory input for local staffing decisions.

primary: package lock and generated asset manifest
shared_ownership.rule: Feature authors use isolated worktrees. Primary integrates shared-file edits serially and validates the combined candidate.

execution_rules: Use Standard speed, at most 16 direct active subagents and depth one.
Activate assignments only for authorized work. Move each story In Progress before work; verify prerequisite acceptance first.
Launch eligible authors first. Start each fresh independent reviewer as author work becomes ready; both roles count against the same ceiling.
Primary owns the Go compiler queue and grants one compiler/test lease at a time. Limit independent Node/TypeScript checks to two concurrent jobs.
Use one browser operator at a time. Terra reviews the integrated visible state while the prescribed check runner validates the same candidate.
Independent source review, required combined checks, browser verification and parent verification precede RFR. Owner demos run at turn end after technical handoff. Terry owns Completed.
Record actual first-author start through last development/review finish; record owner waiting separately.
Refresh the remaining first three execution turns before each handoff. Keep unfinished work and actual readiness visible.

independent_review.scope: Staffing, ownership, gates, resources, dependencies and current ticket mapping.
